description: Open-web method: 11 English/Bengali captured prompts, broad monthly and four weekly November date windows, anti-France/politics and garment/labor searches, regional follow-up and adjacent October/December checks. Regional reporting covered Dhaka and Chittagong. Web search does not replicate LexisNexis; tool totals/native times were unavailable; no exhaustive claim.
required_followup: Use accessible regional archives and source-checked local-language follow-ups if expanding coverage.

description: BNP announced protests for 14–15 November over by-election results and arrests, but searches located announcements without body-verified qualifying executed gatherings. This remains a named unresolved lead, not an event or a claim of absence.
required_followup: Search contemporaneous local reporting for 14–15 November actual gatherings and attendance/state target; announcement alone does not count.

description: September New Age and December TBS describe A-One/Tazreen wage-arrears activity, but do not locate an actual public gathering or establish continuous physical assembly during November. Private employer dispute alone is excluded absent a state-level demand; later government claims require event-specific evidence.
required_followup: Find a November-dated public action and an explicit state-policy demand, plus onset/breaks, before considering any November event.

description: The 28 November Muktijuddho Mancha Shahbagh action has actual occurrence/state demands but no headcount.
required_followup: Find a credible contemporary attendance estimate; do not infer size from traffic disruption or a later planned nationwide action.

description: UNB article for the 7 November minority event was not accessible through the tool; it yielded no body and no HTTP status. Dhaka Tribune carries a report explicitly credited to UNB, while JagoNews24 supplies a separate Chittagong account.
required_followup: No retry on inaccessible URL. Independent review should consider dependency and use a different already permitted source only if material.

description: No independent scientific reviewer examined current evidence hashes; proposed inclusion is not verified provisional and baseline comparison is pending.
required_followup: A distinct reviewer should check crowd estimates, state target, nationwide grouping, boundaries and bounded search coverage.
